summary.zh: 问题反馈的诊断附带更聪明:功能建议不再带环境数据;问题反馈的诊断从最近 5 条失败记录扩到 20 条,并新增最后成功同步时间。
summary.en: Smarter feedback diagnostics: feature requests no longer carry environment data, and bug reports now attach the last 20 redacted failures (up from 5) plus the last successful sync time.

highlights.zh: 选「功能建议」时诊断勾选项整体隐藏、不附带任何环境数据——功能想法与运行环境无关,底部提示语也随之切换;切回「问题反馈」时恢复显示。
highlights.en: Choosing feature request hides the diagnostics option entirely — ideas don't need environment data, and the footer hint adapts; switching back to bug report restores it.

highlights.zh: 问题反馈附带的失败记录从最近 5 条扩到 20 条(保持自动脱敏),覆盖用户描述问题前的一串操作;并附上最后成功同步时间,同步类问题一眼可判。
highlights.en: Bug reports attach the last 20 redacted failures (up from 5) to cover the actions leading up to the reported issue, plus the last successful sync time for instant sync-triage.

highlights.zh: 诊断摘要新增「最后成功同步时间」字段:同步类反馈可以立即判断对端与本地各自的同步状态,不再需要往返追问。
highlights.en: The diagnostics summary gains a last-successful-sync field, so sync-related reports show both sides' state at a glance instead of requiring back-and-forth questions.
